## Hypothesis

VIX compression combined with a gap up and volume surge captures early momentum in SPY. The setup aims to enter when VIX is low, a gap up occurs, and volume spikes, indicating a breakout.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers: VIX1D < 13 for three consecutive 30‑minute periods; SPY gap‑up open > prior day high; first 5‑minute bar after gap shows volume > 1.5× 5‑minute average, closes above gap high, forms bullish BOS (new HH on 5‑minute chart); next bar open entered with bullish candle body and RSI(14) < 70. Exit: stop at most recent swing low; TP1 at 2R; trail 10% off HWM.
